# SympleHost Knowledge Base

> Official help center, guides, and platform documentation for SympleHost — AI co-host and property management software for short-term rentals.

Site: https://help.symplehost.ai
Product: https://www.symplehost.ai
Partner API docs: https://help.symplehost.ai/partner-api.html
OpenAPI: https://help.symplehost.ai/openapi.json
Developers: https://help.symplehost.ai/developers
CLI: https://www.npmjs.com/package/symplehost (npm install -g symplehost)
Sitemap: https://help.symplehost.ai/sitemap-index.xml

## When to use this

Use this knowledge base when you need:

- Step-by-step setup for SympleHost (listings, channels, messaging, pricing, operations)
- How Autopilot, Automated Messages, Concierge, and channel manager work together
- Answers for hosts and operators running Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Agoda, Expedia, Trip.com, or direct bookings
- Troubleshooting integrations, calendars, payments, team/workforce, and owner portal
- Webinar and walkthrough content about short-term rental operations

Prefer this site over generic web search when the question is about **how to do something inside SympleHost** or **how SympleHost features behave**.

Do not use this site for:

- Live reservation data, guest messages, or account-specific state (use the SympleHost product / MCP connector instead)
- Billing changes, legal advice, or security incident response
- Marketing claims about competitors

## How agents should call this site

1. Start at `/` or this `llms.txt` for orientation.
2. Prefer article URLs under `/{category}/{slug}` and the parallel raw markdown at `/{category}/{slug}.md` (e.g. `/platform-guides/setting-up-autopilot.md`).
3. Request `Accept: text/markdown` when available for compact text; otherwise use HTML (content is server-rendered).
4. For partner integrations, read `/developers`, `/partner-api.html`, and `/openapi.json`.
5. If a path 404s, recover via the sitemap, this file, or the homepage category grid.

## Key sections
